brief: Post 1 of the first three @hububbhost posts (Vision). The hububb.com/hosts hero recreated as a post: the Connected to badge of OTA channels above the headline, and inside the iPhone the real Hostie AI chat playing the hero's four beats, Maya checks in and opens the guest portal, the turnover is booked and Sofia confirms, revenue counts up over the animated fortnight chart, and the upcoming stays land with their channel badges. The headline crossfades into the hero's solid Connect your Airbnb button. pillar: category with runs-itself support, funnel: reach.

social.caption:
Meet Hostie, the AI host that runs your property while you watch.

Guests answered in your voice at midnight. The turnover booked before you knew the guest was leaving. Rates that adjust themselves. Hosting with the day-to-day handled, and you still in control.

We are building the autonomous host. This account is where we show it running.

Connect your Airbnb and watch it run.
